shortDescription: Portable, modular valve actuation systems for industrial valves, remote sites, hazardous areas, and water networks.
longDescription: ToughTorq portable valve actuator systems combine a power platform, actuator head, valve adaptor, torque-reaction solution, and application-specific accessories. Selection should be based on required torque, valve geometry, access, operating environment, available utilities, and reaction strategy.
features: Battery, pneumatic, gas, and water-network configurations
Multiple head, adaptor, and reaction configurations
Application-specific torque control and support accessories
